verdict.rationale: Teller is a banking-data API platform, so an official CLI is a fair question to ask, but the evidence pack never mentions one. The only scripted tooling is a community member's own export script (teller-comm-1), which is a user-side workaround, and the React Connect component is an SDK rather than a CLI; neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
